args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.tier = 'enterprise'

transcript.text:
The corrected headline tier is the enterprise tier (customers.tier = 'enterprise'), per the correction insight superseding the earlier "plus" definition. Joining orders to customers with tier = 'enterprise' yields 287 orders.

FINAL ANSWER: 287
